lock_timing: replication source identities and candidate pair family must be frozen before replication results are inspected
eligible_pairs: extension-FDR-significant pairs with abs(rg)>=0.15, passing both h2 gates and the pair-level novelty audit
source_requirements: same or explicitly harmonized phenotype definition
candidate pair family locked before source curation
exact file identity, build, schema, sample size, and local full-resolution SHA256 retained and verified before the replication manifest is locked
completed independent-source search metadata retained even when no qualifying dataset exists
replication trait passes h2 Z>=4 and LDSC intercept<=1.2 before pair testing

success_rule.two_sided_p_threshold: 0.05 divided by the number of replication pairs frozen in the replication family
success_rule.effect_consistency: report discovery and replication rg with SE plus an independent-estimate difference Z, Q, and one-degree-of-freedom heterogeneity P; significance alone is insufficient

failure_reporting: retain null, discordant, underpowered, QC-failed, and evidence-backed unavailable replication attempts in the exact locked candidate family; never replace a failed source after results are known
